def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = grid[0][0]

    # For each color occurring at least twice, extend the line through its
    # first two occurrences in both directions, painting only background cells.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(pts) < 2:
            continue
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = pts[:2]
        dr = r2 - r1
        dc = c2 - c1
        # Reduce the direction to a single step.
        import math
        g = math.gcd(abs(dr), abs(dc))
        dr //= g
        dc //= g

        r, c = r1, c1
        while 0 <= r - dr < h and 0 <= c - dc < w:
            r -= dr
            c -= dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            if grid[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = color
            r += dr
            c += dc
    return out
